source.app_case: BOBJ1 / Interior Girder 2 / ULS_Girder Force uploaded to app-rev1.xlsx [d9e396d4] / BOBJ1 / Interior Girder 2 / U2A / Combination / Bridge Object Girder Forces / Max / Before / set 1

info.evidence: Engineer declaration through force-source selection and Import loads: CSI Correspondence; each row contains simultaneous factored ULS actions for its girder and section face. Raw CSI P signs are retained. This is an engineer declaration, not automatic verification of the CSI export.

force_reference.basis: User CSI screenshots 20261014-110711 and 110915; displayed Y values

u_anchorage.basis: AASHTO 2020 5.10.8.2.4a, 5.10.8.2.1a, 5.10.2.1 and Table 5.10.2.3-1; vertical individual bars, lambda_rc=lambda_er=1; bottom return ignored

geometry_audit.action: Revise / verify the explicit longitudinal cage and strand placement together with the U path. A alone cannot fix conflicting inequalities.
geometry_audit.scope: Physical centreline/radius intersections in the input model. Derived hoop is hypothetical; minimum code clear spacing, construction tolerances and actual drawing verification remain separate.

validation.Meaning / action: 23 input path intersections; explicit bars/strands are not moved silently.
16 intersections with the derived hoop; verify actual cage drawing.
Interface-based hook and straight-leg dimensions only; interior nodal anchorage is a separate check.
Equivalent strip bars and mat crossings do not prove development beyond the actual node face.
Required face areas can be derived from model strut forces; actual available faces and confinement are not established.
Assumed secant springs, perfect embedded bond and associated dilatant friction require calibration.
Software equilibrium and KKT benchmarks do not validate the actual composite structure.

trace.boundary: Girder-only load entry and girder-only support; slab ends are free. Local transfer experiment, not recovered CSI component loading.
limitations: Concrete trace/volume yield domain is assumed; actual nodal faces / splitting / confinement remain unverified.
Conditional slab transverse anchorage/continuity beyond the assigned strip is not established by Be or by bar crossings.
Perfect bond at embedded steel nodes; the continuous U is one physical supply, not additional independent leg/return/tail capacities. Bond and nodal anchorage remain unverified.
Secant springs kn=Emin*Ac/db and kt=0.1kn are numerical assumptions, not measured joint properties.
Associated friction-cone flow has dilation; compatibility is mathematical within this assumed law, not validated physical slip prediction.
A local prismatic transfer experiment cannot establish whole-member composite Tn or a full-span design envelope.
